back.es: el fondo: fund (a sum of money set aside); also bottom, back, background
back.example: We don't have funds for the trip.

note: The money sense shows up mostly in the plural (fondos), and everyday talk about money usually uses dinero or plata, so the editor might think about a card for the more common "background" sense or the phrase "en el fondo" (deep down) as well.
